title: The Memory--Energy Frontier in Noisy Recurrent Inference: A Spectral Rate--Distortion Framework for Neural and Neuromorphic Systems
description: A reproducible synthetic benchmark coupling a scalar recurrent estimator's stationary mean-squared error, a declared dimensionless activity proxy, a learned gain surrogate, and hard feasibility projection. The paper explicitly does not claim measured neural or hardware energy savings. This file is prepared metadata only; no Zenodo deposition or DOI issuance is implied.
